name: The Stock
gain: Stored in cipher.x.stock (0–5). This track is not per region. It runs across the whole run and is read at the Finale.

steps.name: Samples
steps.rule: Any liaison leaves a region unbeaten

steps.name: Shipments
steps.rule: Any region's Apex Shadow enters the Region of Doom
steps.note: That Apex stands guard in Phase 4

steps.name: Three Beasts
steps.rule: Raikou, Entei and Suicune were all shipped from Johto
steps.note: The three liaisons who hold them return together

steps.name: The Reading
steps.rule: cipher.lugia-reading is set (Johto Raid 5 Failed or Declined)

steps.name: Complete
steps.rule: Five or more regions were lost or stayed out of
steps.note: The Finale's timer is 2 turns shorter

name: The Ledger Fills
gain: A step is gained when a raid is failed or declined, or when the climax is scheduled. A step is removed by a raid Success or better. Stored in rocket.x.ledger (0–5).

steps.name: Small Print
steps.rule: One shop per city charges +10% ("insurance")

steps.name: House Rules
steps.rule: Game Corner prizes are Black-Label; one Pokémon Center per city closes at night

steps.name: Closed Roads
steps.rule: Two routes are blocked by a Snorlax; detour nodes appear

steps.name: Export
steps.rule: Wild encounter pools near Vermilion shrink by a quarter (poached)

steps.name: Under New Management
steps.rule: Saffron's gates are shut before the climax; the news runs Rocket adverts

name: The Signal Spreads
gain: Stored in rocket-return.x.signal (0–5). Gained and removed as in the design note §4.

steps.name: Static
steps.rule: Radios in rest nodes play static; the Pokégear map loses one node of preview

steps.name: Jingle
steps.rule: Shops play the Rocket jingle; Slowpoke tails appear in one shop per city

steps.name: Rage
steps.rule: Wild Pokémon near water are one evolution stage higher at 20% odds

steps.name: Carrier Wave
steps.rule: The signal reaches the next region's border; one Kanto-style Black-Label Pokémon appears on Executive teams

steps.name: The Call
steps.rule: Every radio carries Archer's voice; the climax is scheduled

name: The Long Weather
gain: Stored in hoenn.x.weather (0–5). A second value, hoenn.x.tilt (−3 to +3), records which team is ahead: Aqua negative, Magma positive. Raids against one team move the tilt toward the other.

steps.name: Drizzle and Drought
steps.rule: One route is rainy and one is sunny at all times

steps.name: Blue Dawn, Red Dusk
steps.rule: Weather at each node is set by the tilt (ties alternate)

steps.name: The Swing
steps.rule: Weather flips every two turns in wild battles

steps.name: Spill
steps.rule: Berry trees fail on one side of the region; ferries or cable cars stop, by tilt

steps.name: The Awakening
steps.rule: Rain and harsh sun arrive together; the climax is scheduled

name: The Subtraction
gain: Stored in galactic.x.subtraction (0–5). Step 3 has three parts, one per lake, and each is its own flag.

steps.name: Quiet
steps.rule: One clinic per city; a Pokémon left there for a node returns with the Spiritless rule for 3 battles

steps.name: Brownout
steps.rule: Pokémon Centers heal to 80%; night nodes are darker (accuracy −5% for both sides)

steps.name: Lake Acuity taken (Uxie)
steps.rule: Memory: the map shows one fewer node ahead

steps.name: Lake Verity taken (Mesprit)
steps.rule: Feeling: friendship and bond gains are halved

steps.name: Lake Valor taken (Azelf)
steps.rule: Will: the player's Pokémon cannot land critical hits

steps.name: The Hum
steps.rule: Wild Pokémon flee less and fight less; shops forget one item in stock

steps.name: Zero Hour
steps.rule: Clocks stop at each rest node until the player leaves; the climax is scheduled

steps.name: Pamphlets
steps.rule: One speech per city; wild pools gain "released" Pokémon that will not fight back on the first turn

steps.name: Let Go
steps.rule: The PC holds four fewer Pokémon ("on deposit for liberation"); returned when the step is removed

steps.name: The Frost Line
steps.rule: The northern third of the map is under snow: ice hazards, Ice moves +10% for both sides

steps.name: The Bridges
steps.rule: Two of five bridges are closed; routes across them cost an extra node

steps.name: The Crown
steps.rule: Snow everywhere; the climax is scheduled

steps.name: Invitations
steps.rule: One boutique per city refuses the player; Flare recruiters appear at city nodes

steps.name: Blackout
steps.rule: Half of each city is dark: night rules apply there at all hours

steps.name: Members First
steps.rule: Pokémon Centers heal members first: the player's heal is 85% unless carrying a Flare badge

steps.name: Prime Time
steps.rule: The Holo Caster interrupts once per stage; shop stock shows "reserved for members" on two items

steps.name: Countdown
steps.rule: A timer on every screen; the climax is scheduled

steps.name: Tags
steps.rule: One trial-site node per island is vandalized and closed

steps.name: Borrowed
steps.rule: After any lost battle a random benched Pokémon may be "borrowed" for 3 nodes (always returned)

steps.name: Donations
steps.rule: Aether staff stand at Pokémon Centers; wild encounter pools shrink by a fifth

steps.name: Thin Places
steps.rule: Once per stage a wild battle is interrupted by a glimpse of an Ultra Beast (one attack, then gone)

steps.name: The Gate
steps.rule: Daylight dims by a third; the climax is scheduled

steps.name: Sponsored
steps.rule: Partner shops sell at −5%; each purchase there adds +1 Heat (they report it)

steps.name: Tremors
steps.rule: Once per stage a wild Pokémon Dynamaxes for one turn with no Power Spot

steps.name: Red Cloud
steps.rule: Wild Area weather is fixed; Dynamax in dens lasts one extra turn for the foe

steps.name: Service Suspended
steps.rule: Rail and air nodes cost an extra step; one shop per city has "supply issues"

steps.name: Launch Day
steps.rule: The sky is red; the climax is scheduled

name: Attendance
gain: Stored in star.x.attendance (0–5). Here the track does not measure the team's progress. It measures how badly the adults are handling it.

steps.name: Empty Desks
steps.rule: Star flyers at school and town nodes; Star Grunts ask a toll of nothing but a battle

steps.name: Five Bases
steps.rule: Routes near a Base have a checkpoint; friendly if the player has a Star badge

steps.name: Ultimatum
steps.rule: The Academy posts expulsion notices; shops near the Academy will not serve anyone with a Star badge

steps.name: Buyers
steps.rule: "Scholarship officers" at every Base gate; one in three Star Grunts met is a Cipher Peon in costume

steps.name: Barrage
steps.rule: Five engines audible from anywhere in Mesagoza; the climax is scheduled
